title: Protectt.ai takes majority stake in Bosch-incubated AIShield to build security platform
summary: Protectt.ai acquires majority stake in Bosch-incubated AIShield to build security platform
detailed: Protectt.ai, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, has invested through a mix of primary and secondary share purchases. The business — AI Shield Private Limited — will operate as a separate entity, with existing intellectual property transferred to it, founder and chief executive Manish Mimani told E
